text: Wafi is Rawafid Schools Group's assistant. It uses generative AI to draft replies to your questions about your child's attendance, lateness and fees. To answer, it reads your child's first name and this term's counts from our records; nothing else is sent. Questions about health, safety, custody, complaints or a disputed fee always go to a member of staff, who replies to you. We use your messages only to answer them, under our agreement with you as a parent, keep them for 90 days and share them with no one outside Rawafid. You may ask a person at any time: call your campus office or write "staff". You have the right to know about, see, correct and ask us to delete your data. Questions: our data protection officer, Nasser Al-Mansour, privacy@rawafid.example.
